verses.text: After Abimelech, Tola son of Puah, grandson of Dodo, from Issachar, stepped up to rescue Israel. He lived in Shamir, in Ephraim’s hill country. 🛡️
Tola led Israel for twenty-three years. Then he died and was buried in Shamir. 🕊️
After him, Jair from Gilead stepped up and led Israel for twenty-two years. 🌿
He had thirty sons who rode thirty young donkeys. They owned thirty towns, still called Jair’s Villages in Gilead. 🫏
Jair died and was buried in Kamon. 🕊️

Once again, Israel did what Yahweh said was wrong. They worshiped the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Syria, Sidon, Moab, Ammon, and the Philistines. They abandoned Yahweh and stopped serving him. 😔
Yahweh became angry with Israel and handed them over to the Philistines and the Ammonites. ⚖️
That year the enemies crushed and oppressed Israel. For eighteen years they kept pressing all the Israelites east of the Jordan, in Gilead, the land of the Amorites. 😟
The Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim too, and Israel was in deep trouble. ⚔️
Then Israel’s people cried to Yahweh: ‘We’ve sinned against you. We abandoned our God and worshiped the Baals.’ 🙏
Yahweh answered Israel: ‘Didn’t I rescue you from Egypt, the Amorites, the Ammonites, and the Philistines? 📜
‘The Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you too. You cried to me, and I rescued you from them. 🛡️
‘But you abandoned me again and served other gods. So I won’t rescue you this time. 😞
‘Go ahead—cry out to the gods you chose. Let them rescue you when trouble hits!’ ⚠️
Israel’s people said to Yahweh, ‘We’ve sinned. Do whatever seems right to you—just please rescue us today.’ 🙏
They got rid of the foreign gods among them and served Yahweh. And Yahweh could no longer bear to see Israel suffer. 💔
Then the Ammonites gathered and camped in Gilead. Israel’s people gathered too and camped at Mizpah. 🏕️
Gilead’s people and leaders asked each other, ‘Who will step up first to fight the Ammonites? He’ll lead everyone living in Gilead.’ 📣
